hook.note: hook lines stacked in the lower third under the face, plain white like every caption (18 Oct, carried from the Kyle rounds: no shadow, no colour)

captions.stack_rule: only short punchy lines (<=3 words) that land a beat: rhetorical questions, answers, 'nobody else', 'right now'. Longer lines fall back to over_aroll.

broll.cut_on: phrase boundaries; one shot per phrase, or one shot across two short phrases that share an idea
broll.aroll_lines: hook first line, 'I' claims and opinions, rhetorical questions to camera, the direct ask/CTA, and the last line
match_order: planned shot from the shot list
literal: the person/place/object/action named in the line
embodied: a movement or image that acts the line out (walking away = leaving, looking back = turn back, sunset = payoff)
never: the same clip twice in one video
clips of other people talking to camera
client footage unless the line is about client work

end_card: WELLSINTHELOOP stutter card (in perception project, last 0.96s, V1-V3 'Text' items)
glossary: Eoin Wells, Wellset Media, Kyle Ritchie, Glasgow, Dublin, Ireland, seminar, DJs, founders, Morelife

aroll.note: every A-roll join b-roll can't hide gets a toggled 112% punch-in

face_push.note: slow push-in on face stretches, reset under b-roll (PPC VSL)

audio.music_note: background only, hits from frame one, no notdavid

intro_zoom.note: short zoom-out with brief motion blur, no whoosh

joins: no jump cuts: every A-roll join hidden by b-roll, checked frame-exact with engine/verify_joins.py
text_rule: plain white only, no shadows, no colour, no gimmicks, nothing over the face

deliver.vertical: engine/vertical.py <reel> "<headline>" <out> for 9:16 with the headline in the top bar
deliver.start: first word of the point, never a connective lead-in

graphics_font.note: 18 Oct: 'my font is helvetica' - every motion graphic and card uses Helvetica (Bold for headings), same as the captions
